book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kangunlamiha mundu ywakalelebhalite
Yesu kakikwela mubhwato, kakiyomboka lihibha na kuhika mu kitami kyabhe.

Linjubha alyo alyo bhakinnyeghela mundu ywakalelebhalite, kaghonjekwa mu likahe. Yesu pakabhonitie kuhyubhalila kwabhe, kakinng'ombela yula ywakalelebhalite, “Ghukotoke kutunyuka mwoyo mwana ghwangu, ghulekekehwa ulemwa ghwako.”
Kwakya nnando aghwo, amoo bha ahunda bha malaghilo bhakiyanda kuhwacha mu myoyo yabhe, “Mundu ayu kangukundula.”
Peni Yesu kakighamanya mahwacho ghabhe, kakiaghombela, “Kiyaha niki munguhwacha uhokelo mu myoyo yenu?
Kyoki kiibheghite kiyeyebhu, kulongela, ‘Ulemwa ghwako ghulekekehwa,’ ebu kulongela, ‘Ghuyime ghutyange?’

Peni nungupala mmanye kukita Mwana ywa Mundu kabhegha na makakala gha kulekekeha ulemwa mu nnima” Ndo kakinng'ombela yula mundu ywakalelebhalite, “Ghuyime ghutole likahe lyako na ghughende ukaya kwako.”
Yula mundu kakiyima, na kakighenda ukaya kwake.
Bhandu bhoha mulula lumati paabhonite agho bhakiyingilwa lyogha, bhakintika Chapanga, ywakaapeghite makakala ghala kwa bhandu.
Yesu kangunkema Matayu
Yesu pakabheghite mu kubhuka akwo, kakimmona mundu yumu lihina lyake Matayu katama pakusulumula sumu. Kakinng'ombela, “Ghundughile.” Matayu kakibhuka na kakintughila.
Yesu pakabheghite mulubhagha lya Matayu katama kulyegha hilyo, asumula sumu atangalo na bhanaulemwa bhakihika kutama papamu naywo na ahundwa bhake.
Afalisayu paabhonite milando ayi, bhakiakonya ahundwa bhake, “Kiyaha niki nhunda ghwenu kangulyegha papamu na asumula sumu na bhanaulemwa?”
Peni Yesu pakaghayihwite agho kakiaghombela, “Bhandu bhanga utamwa bhangumpomela ng'obhe nng'anga ngati bhala bhanautamwa bhangumpomela.
Basi, nng'ende mukalihunde fwambulo ya malagho agha, ‘Ningupomela lipyanda, ngati chepa nyambi.’ Kiyaha hika ng'obhe kuakema bhaabheghiti bha maha, ngati bhanaulemwa.”
Yesu kangukonywa kwakya kulikunga
Ahundwa ghwa Yohane yunakubatisa bhakihika na kunkonya Yesu, “Kya bhuli twenga na Akaafalisayu tungulikunga, peni ahundwa bhako bhangulikunga ng'obhe?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Bhuli, ahenja bha yunakutolela bhaahotola bhuli kukukulika paabhegha na yunakutolela? Linjubha lyahika pakabhuka bambo yunakutolela, apo ndo bhatalikunga.”
“Kahone mundu ywakapabhika kipabhiko kya hyono mu likama, kiyaha kila kipabhiko kyakakuka mu likama alyo na pala pakapabhikiti paayonjokeheka.

Ebu bhandu angubhika ng'obhe difwai ya hyono mu nhako ghwa liyula ghuuhakaliti. Handa paatenda naha ghula nhako ghwa liyula lwaabaluka na difwai ya yitika. Na nhako ghwa liyula lyakanjaghanika, peni difwai ya hyono yabhikwaha mu hibhigha ya liyula lya hyono, na hibhigha yaabhegha tela.”
Nhinja ywa kilongohi na nhumbu ywakabyalite lipinda lya Yesu

Yesu pakabheghite kangulongela agho, kamu kakiyingila kilongohi ywa nyumba ya kukonganila Akaayahudi, kakinchutamila mayughwa muulongolo ghwake na kunng'ombela, “Nhinja ghwangu kahwegha hinu hinu. Peni ghughende na ghunnyabhikile kibhoko kyako naywo katalama.”
Yesu kakibhuka na kakilongohana naywo, ahundwa bhake nabho bhakintughila.
Lisaa alyo alyo nndala yumu ywakabheghite na liholobhela kwa ngungwa kumi na ibhili, kakinhikila Yesu kya kuhyetu na kakilibyala lipinda lyake,
Kiyaha kakilighombela mumwoyo ghwake, “Handa ndalibyala lipinda lyake, ndaalama.”
Yesu kakikilibhuka, naywo pakammonitie kakinng'ombela, “Nhinja ghwangu, ghukotoke kutunyuka mwoyo, kuhyubhalila kwako kukulamiha.” Naywo yula nndala kakilama lisaa lilalila.
Yesu pakahikite kulubhagha lwa yula kilongohi ywa nyumba ya kukonganila Ayahudi, kakiabhona bhandu bhakipyemba filimbi na lumati lwa bhandu lukibhegha lungukukulika,
kakiaghombela, “Mmuke, kiyaha nhinja kahwegha ng'obhe ngati kaghonja.” Peni bhombe bhakinheka.
Mbole lumati lwa bhandu lukibhuhwa panje, Yesu kakiyingila unyumba na kakinkamula kibhoko, yula nhinja kakiyumuka.
Mihalo ayi yikikwila munnima ghula ghwoha.
Yesu kangualamiha bhangabhona abhili
Yesu pakabheghite mukubhuka pala, bhangabhona abhili bhakintughila, bhakiyobha kyobho na bhakilongela, “Mwana ywa Daudi ghutupeghe lipyanda.”
Yesu pakayingiliti munyumba bhala bhangabhona bhakinhikila. Naywo kakiakonya, “Munguhyubhalila kukita ndahotola kutenda nnando aghu?” Bhakinnyanga, “Ena Bambo.”
Ndo Yesu kakiabyala meho ghabhe na kulongela, “Na yibheghe kwa mwenga handa panhyubhalila.”
Meho ghabhe ghakihughuka. Yesu kakiakanikiha, pakalongela, “Nnole, mundu ywohele kakotoke kughumanya nnando aghu.”
Peni bhombe bhakighenda na kulandamiha mihalo ya Yesu mu nnima ghula ghwoha.
Yesu kangunnamiha ywangahotola kulongela
Bandu bhala abhili paabheghite bhangubhuka, mundu yumu ywakakwelitwe na mandilu na ywakabheghite ng'obhe na uhotolo ghwa kulongela kakiyeghwa kwa Yesu.
Kamu, palibhuhitwe lila lindilu, yula ywangahotola kulongela kakilongela. Lula lumati lwa bhandu lukikangacha na kulongela, “Nnando handa aghu ghunabhonekana ng'obhe mu Isilaeli.”
Peni Afalisayu bhakilongela, “Aywo kangughabhuha mandilu kwa makakala gha nkulu ghwa mandilu.”
Atendalihengu bhamandina
Yesu kakityangila muhitami hyoha na hijiji, pakahunda munyumba hyabhe hya kukonganila Akaayahudi, pakalandamiha Nhalo ghwa Maha ghwa Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga na kulamiha atamwa kwoha mu bhandu.
Pakaabhonita bhandu himati himati kakiabhonela luhungu kiyaha bhangughaya kyangali utangwo, handa mene bhangali na nhakila.
Habhu kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Mabeno ndo matangalo peni atendalihengo bhamandina,
Basi, munnyupe Bambo ywa mabeno, ngati kabhalaghile atendalihengo bhabene mabeno ghake.”
